versions.subject: Merge PR #4732 from @MATTANDERS0N - Add rules related to CVE-2024-1709 & CVE-2024-1708 exploitation
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4663
    ObjectType: 'File'
    AccessMask: '0x6'
    ObjectName|endswith: '.xml'
    ObjectName|contains|all:
        - 'Temp'
        - 'ScreenConnect'
    ProcessName|contains: 'ScreenConnect.Service.exe'
condition: selection
